decisions_log.decision: Used SVG paths for Sun/Moon icons instead of Lucide-react
decisions_log.rationale: Avoids adding a new dependency; inline SVGs are zero-cost and the icon shapes are simple enough to inline directly.

decisions_log.decision: Used useSyncExternalStore with a module-level pub-sub instead of useState+useEffect for theme state
decisions_log.rationale: The eslint-config-next rule react-hooks/set-state-in-effect forbids calling setState directly inside useEffect bodies. useSyncExternalStore with explicit listener notification from within the event handler satisfies the linter, avoids cascading renders, and remains hydration-safe.

decisions_log.decision: Used useSyncExternalStore asymmetric snapshots (server=false, client=true) for mount detection in ThemeToggle
decisions_log.rationale: The idiomatic React 18 replacement for the useEffect+setMounted(true) pattern; no extra render cycle, no act() boundary issues in tests.

decisions_log.decision: Blocking FOUC script reads localStorage then falls back to window.matchMedia prefers-color-scheme
decisions_log.rationale: Satisfies AC1 (OS preference on first visit) and AC2 (stored preference persists) without any server-side knowledge of the user's preference.

files_changed.summary: React Context provider managing light/dark theme via useSyncExternalStore + module-level pub-sub. Reads initial theme from the DOM class set by the anti-FOUC blocking script. Exposes useTheme hook.

Client-side icon toggle (SVG Sun/Moon). Uses useSyncExternalStore for hydration-safe mount detection, then delegates to useTheme. Renders a same-size placeholder on the server to prevent layout shift.
Added blocking inline script in <head> to prevent FOUC by applying .dark to <html> before paint. Wrapped body in ThemeProvider and placed ThemeToggle in the persistent site header.
Added Tailwind v4 @custom-variant dark rule (class strategy) and .dark CSS block with dark-mode background/foreground tokens.
Unit tests for ThemeProvider: blocking-script logic, initial state sync from DOM, toggleTheme state/DOM/localStorage changes, and useTheme-outside-provider error.
Unit tests for ThemeToggle: button rendering, aria-label accuracy per theme, DOM class and localStorage mutations on click.

self_assessment.notes: All three repo checks pass: jest (24/24 tests), eslint (0 errors, 0 warnings), next build (TypeScript clean). The implementation stays within the four components_touched listed in the sketch. No third-party theme library was added. Tailwind class strategy is used throughout.
